purpose: Fabricated risk classification, anomaly detection, and human-review prioritization.
target_meaning: Noisy simulator outcome; not observed fraud or legal guilt.
feature_policy: Numeric finite non-negative features; rates in [0,1]; counts integral; no identifiers, dates, or labels in model inputs.
temporal_policy: Features available by decision; training labels available before validation; validation labels available before test.
queue_policy: Label-free, deterministic, capacity-bounded human-review queue; no automated adverse action.
